channel.title: Addigy incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Addigy's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Post-Maintenance Login and Data Viewing Issues [resolved]
Addigy Cloud Interface Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Logging in to Addigy is working as expected. If you continue to see errors, please open a support ticket and we will assist.

item.title: Issue affecting Apple Push Notification service (APNs) certificates [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. To create or renew your push certificate, first download a fresh AddigyCSR.plist from your Addigy instance, then upload it to Apple’s APNs portal. An older AddigyCSR.plist file will not work. If you still see errors after using a newly downloaded file, please open a support ticket and we will assist.
